2. Tamil Nadu ranked second after Karnataka.
3. Tamil Nadu ranked second after Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Tamil Nadu's per capita income was ₹4.08 lakh and it ranked second after Karnataka; it did not rank second after Andhra Pradesh.
tq: Use the reversed-comparison trap in the ranking statement.
